blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Super Typhoon Rosal (international name: Champi) will bring heavy rains and gusty winds over several areas in Northern and Southern Luzon from Wednesday to Friday. This forecast was given during the climate forum of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). Weather specialist Benison Estareja said that while Rosal will not make a landfall in our country, it is expected to be the nearest to Northern Luzon on Thursday. Based on its 11 a.m. weather bulletin, Rosal was last estimated 845 kilometers east of Northern Luzon. Batanes was also placed under Wind Signal No. 2 while […]...
